01 About me

Beyond the numbers.
Into the bigger picture.

I’m drawn to the intersection of financial analysis, business strategy, and the decisions that shape a company’s future.

My path has taken me from studying business administration in Berlin to hands-on roles in audit, corporate finance, and hospitality finance. Along the way, I’ve worked with group financial statements, supported a post-merger integration, and explored what sets private equity acquisitions apart.

Now, at the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, I’m deepening that foundation through a Master in Finance with an investment banking specialization.
